description: Give your items that have no photo the top product photo found for their brand, name, and model. Photos are saved straight away, with no confirm step; an item that already has a photo is never touched. Works on up to 20 items a call. Each search uses one image suggestion from this month's allowance. When the allowance runs out, the rest are reported as left and the call still succeeds. To change a photo use suggest_item_image and apply_item_image; to undo one use revert_item_image.

item_ids.description: Fill exactly these items, up to 20. Omit to take the newest items that have no photo

limit.description: Items to work on. Defaults to 20, the maximum

list_type.description: Limit to one list. Omit for every list, gifts included. Ignored with item_ids

offset.description: Items without a photo to skip first. Ignored with item_ids

name: fill_missing_images
title: Fill missing photos
